episode_summary: In this episode, Valerie Fitzgerald shares her inspiring journey from a struggling single mother to a top luxury real estate agent. She discusses the importance of embracing fear, leveraging AI, and continuously reinventing oneself to succeed in the competitive real estate market. Valerie's story and strategies offer valuable insights for agents at all stages of their careers.
